mapper.sql: FF.FOLDER_ID, FF.FOLDER_NAME, FF.PARENT_ID, FF.SCOPE, FF.DEPTNO, FF.CREATOR, FF.CREATOR_NAME, TO_CHAR(FF.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT_STR, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FILE_SHARE FS WHERE FS.FOLDER_ID = FF.FOLDER_ID) AS FILE_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FILE_FOLDER SF WHERE SF.PARENT_ID = FF.FOLDER_ID) AS SUB_FOLDER_COUNT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FILE_FOLDER (FOLDER_ID, FOLDER_NAME, PARENT_ID, SCOPE, DEPTNO, CREATOR, CREATOR_NAME, CREATED_AT) VALUES (FILE_FOLDER_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{folderName}, #{parentId}, #{scope}, #{deptno}, #{creator}, #{creatorName}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE FILE_SHARE SET FOLDER_ID = NULL WHERE FOLDER_ID = #{folderId}
